messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH - Private VPC tenant egress spike + 5xx for tenant 'Arboretum' in eu-west-1. Alert group: network-health. Escalation to oncall.
alice (oncall): I got the page, jumping in. Observed ~40% 502/504 from arboretum -> backend NLB in privnet.
josh (cs-rep): Customer reporting intermittent API timeouts and failures since ~02:05 UTC. They're seeing tokenized failures across many requests.
miguel (sre): Confirming graphs: egress TX spike from tenant veth, NLB target group health shows spikes in latency and >20% unhealthy at 02:07. Logs show TLS handshake resets.
tara (net-eng): Possible asymmetric routing or NLB health probe sensitivity. Did anything change in SGs or route tables?
alice (oncall): No config deploys in privnet windows per deploy-bot, last infra change 01:10.
deploy-bot: deploy:infra removed: none in last 6h.
olga (prod-eng): We rolled a model variant earlier but only for hosted; no private changes.
hema (security): Quick check: no recent SG rule additions. WAF logs normal.
miguel (sre): Correlating: NAT gateway attachment flapped at 02:06 for that tenant's dedicated private pool instance, causing connections to drop then re-establish => NLB showing unhealthy until backend recovery.
tara (net-eng): If NAT instance or route-table propagation is intermittent, healthchecks will fail. Two mitigation ideas: 1) Shift affected tenant traffic to standby dedicated pool in same region, 2) Relax NLB healthcheck settings temporarily to avoid premature backend removal.
josh (cs-rep): Customer impact: Real-time text-generation features degrade; CS asked to inform them we're doing an active mitigation and ETA ~20-30m.
alice (oncall): Start mitigation 1 and 2 in parallel. Tara, can you run pool shift? Miguel, adjust NLB healthcheck. I'll coordinate comms.
tara (net-eng): Starting tenant migration: updating routing to point Arboretum's VPC attachment to pool-standby-eu-west-1. Command: 
```
# map vpc-attach
redwoodctl net route attach --tenant arboretum --from pool-dedicated-eu1 --to pool-standby-eu1
```
Executing now.
miguel (sre): Editing NLB healthcheck: increase interval and unhealthy threshold. Patch applied to target-group tg-arb-01: 
```
aws elbv2 modify-target-group-health-check --target-group-arn arn:... --health-check-interval-seconds 15 --healthy-threshold-count 3 --unhealthy-threshold-count 6
```
apply succeeded. Expect fewer flaps.
alice (oncall): Noted - lowering sensitivity to avoid cascade removals.
deploy-bot: route-change: started 3798642105 by tara (net-eng)
ara (system): DNS: arboretum.internal.redwood -> alias to nlb-arb-standby updated, TTL 30s while migration in progress.
josh (cs-rep): Letting customer know we're shifting traffic and adjusting probes; will update in 10m.
miguel (sre): Post-change metrics: error rate falling from 22% to 6% over 2m; NLB target healthy count increasing. Latency normalizing.
alice (oncall): On-call handoff note: if errors do not drop below 2% by +15m, escalate to platform-eng for kernel/sysctl investigation.
hema (security): During route shift we saw a denied packet burst from a legacy SG rule. I pushed a temporary allow for ephemeral port range for the tenant-to-pool path, rule id sg-temp-allow-379864. Reverting once healthy.
tara (net-eng): Migration confirming: pool-standby capacity ok, no CPU/GPU contention. Rolling cutover finished at 02:20.
miguel (sre): Final check: no further TLS resets in connection logs; healthchecks stable; we've queued a rollback path if we need to revert to original pool.
josh (cs-rep): Customer update sent: "Mitigation applied; most traffic healthy; follow-up in 30m or earlier if we detect regression." They responded :thumbsup:.
alice (oncall): Incident classification: P2 - tenant-specific network egress outage caused by NAT instance flapping + sensitive NLB probe. Resolution: Shift to standby pool, relax healthchecks, temporary SG allow. Postmortem required.
olga (prod-eng): I'll own postmortem with net-eng and SRE. Requesting logs: NAT instance console output, NLB target metrics, route table diff.
miguel (sre): Collected artefacts and uploaded to /shared/incidents/3798642000/ (nat-logs.gz, elb-metrics.csv, route-diff.txt).
alice (oncall): Creating incident ticket and scheduling 1h runbook review at 09:00 UTC. Action items: (1) Harden NAT instance ASG and scale policies, (2) Add circuit-breaker in routing to auto-failover to standby earlier, (3) Revisit NLB probe defaults for private fleets, (4) Revoke sg-temp-allow after confirmation.
hema (security): I'll revert sg-temp-allow once postmortem verified — leaving a marker for audit.
deploy-bot: incident-closed: preliminary mitigation successful, monitoring for 1h before final close.
alice (oncall): Thanks team. If anyone sees recurrence ping here.
josH (typo): (ignore)
